name: Stephen Rannazzisi
biography: ​From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Stephen Rannazzisi (born July 4, 1978) is an American actor who has appeared in Paul Blart: Mall Cop and currently is featured in the FX television show The League. He hails from Smithtown, New York, on Long Island. Description above from the Wikipedia article Stephen Rannazzisi, licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.
